title: supertoolkit.yaml: the forge services AgentPod writes
description: The stk policy file (`/etc/stk/supertoolkit.yaml` on a station, YAML, mode 0640) as AgentPod's node-agent edits it, written as JSON Schema over the YAML's data model: a reader parses the YAML, then validates the value. stk parses it with supertoolkit internal/policy/config.go (`file`, Parse) and refuses the whole file on any bad entry, so `stk reload` leaves the previous policy in force. Only `services` is contracted: other top-level keys (`workspace`, `profiles`, `servers`, `egress` and the rest) are the operator's and pass through untouched, as do built-in services. A service with `kind: forge` must match the forge shape below, and may not take a built-in name (contracts/supertoolkit/builtin-services.json). What a schema cannot say, stk checks on load: a host used by two services, a forge rule pattern, and one owner across an app grant's repositories.

propertyNames.description: AgentPod's service-name rule (stkpolicy.CheckServiceName); stk refuses `.scope-` in a forge name.

forge.description: A `kind: forge` service: the keys AgentPod's node-agent writes (apps/node-agent/internal/forgeapi/stkpolicy/policy.go, `serviceOut`), plus `api_prefix`, which stk accepts and AgentPod cannot yet write. stk's own decoding of a service ignores unknown keys and also reads `scopes`, `capabilities`, `device` and `oauth2`; this contract holds a forge service to the set both sides agree on.

host.description: A bare hostname: no scheme, port, path or spaces (stk catalog/forge.go, checkHost).

api_prefix.description: The forge's API path prefix; empty or absent means the provider's default (`/api/v1` for Forgejo and Gitea, `/2.0` for Bitbucket, none for github.com and `/api/v3` for GitHub Enterprise). stk does not check it further.

auth.description: Empty means token. `app` is a GitHub App grant.

scheme.description: Empty means bearer. Forgejo and Gitea take `token`.

env_var.description: The variable a brokered child reads the placeholder from.

repositories.description: The `owner/name` pairs the grant covers. With `auth: app` they share one owner, which a schema cannot say; stk refuses otherwise.

rules.description: Request rules after the preset's. stk refuses any key but allow, deny and when, and parses the patterns itself.

labels.description: Audit labels copied onto every row stk writes. stk refuses any other key; AgentPod marks its own entries by `grant`, and a copied shared entry by a `grant` starting `shared:`.
